scenario: Clean mature release for each supported selector
expected: Pass with the shared result schema and exit 0

scenario: Applicable advisory, confirmed deprecation or confirmed retraction, with or without incomplete evidence
expected: Fail takes precedence over review and blocks installation

scenario: Too young or missing date; zero age option
expected: Review normally; zero skips only age rule

scenario: Provider default missing, with and without an explicit version
expected: Versionless check reviews with DEFAULT_UNAVAILABLE; exact check evaluates the requested release

scenario: Timeout, malformed or oversized response, or OSV pagination failure
expected: Required metadata failures yield METADATA_UNAVAILABLE; incomplete advisory queries yield ADVISORIES_INCOMPLETE

scenario: Withdrawn and duplicate OSV records across pages
expected: Withdrawn ignored; active IDs deduplicated and sorted

scenario: Scoped npm name, PyPI normalization, Go module path and Maven coordinate
expected: Provider receives the normalized and encoded identity

scenario: Pass then install with stub executable for each native adapter
expected: Exact argv, current directory, inherited stdin and separate raw stdout/stderr; no extra check

scenario: Blocked check, manager launch failure, native exit or cancellation
expected: Blocked check and launch failure exit 1; preserve native exit status; cancellation is nonzero

scenario: Invalid input, shell metacharacters, unsupported selector or unavailable install adapter
expected: No shell evaluation or file changes; unsupported operations fail before network

scenario: Native stub writes progress then waits for stdin before exit
expected: Progress reaches its native stream before exit; no whole-process buffering

scenario: Credential-bearing provider error or terminal controls in upstream identifiers
expected: Own diagnostics omit credentials and raw bodies; identifiers cannot inject terminal instructions

scenario: Check outside Git without project config, manifest, lockfile or native tool
expected: Built-in age/Markdown defaults and normal shared package-only checks; no local tool executes

scenario: Language and manager aliases across check, install and list
expected: Equivalent aliases share results and adapters; Kotlin and Java share Maven checks but retain separate install and manifest adapters

scenario: Each required check and install capability
expected: Shared check contract and exact-version installation with the default manager

scenario: Supported check with no install adapter
expected: Install exits 2 before network access or mutation

scenario: Pub or Swift metadata missing a required date or default; ambiguous Swift release identity
expected: Missing or ambiguous provider evidence yields review; invalid user input exits 2

scenario: Exact-version Kotlin and Swift installs
expected: Invoke the correct manager and preserve unrelated declaration content

scenario: Missing, partial and complete project defaults; explicit overrides including zero and markdown
expected: Built-ins fill absent fields; file supplies defaults; explicit flags win; --json and --format json agree and conflicting flags exit 2

scenario: Nested cwd with nearest config; multiple ancestors; .git file/directory boundary; standalone cwd with ancestor config but no Git boundary
expected: Inside Git use nearest file up to boundary inclusive; outside Git use only cwd and ignore ancestor configs; no merge; native cwd stays at invocation directory

scenario: Unreadable or invalid CUE; unknown fields; negative/fractional age; invalid format; imports or nonconcrete values
expected: Exit 2 before network/execution/mutation even with overriding CLI flags; help/version still work without loading config

scenario: Configured format json on install and explicit install formatting flags
expected: Configured age applies to the one pre-install check; configured format is ignored; native streams remain raw; explicit --json or --format exits 2

scenario: Passing check followed by missing manager, host executable, wrapper or known runtime
expected: Exit 1 before any install mutation; no automatic installation or fallback; stderr identifies missing component and gives brief macOS guidance plus an official URL; aliases share the same guidance

scenario: Older installed manager or pinned wrapper
expected: No tool version gate or upgrade; package selection and age policy are unchanged

scenario: Standalone check or blocked install with no manager installed
expected: Neither path looks up or starts a native tool

scenario: Go and Python manifests in a mixed repo and nested module
expected: Read only the selected invocation-relative inputs; missing local manifest exits 2

scenario: Direct and transitive lock entries, ranges, conflicts and distinct scopes
expected: Only direct rows; exact versions include provenance; unknowns and scopes agree across formats

scenario: Gradle catalog references, computed Swift declarations and empty manifests
expected: List only referenced catalog entries; mark unenumerable declarations partial and exit 1; complete empty list exits 0

scenario: Offline list and list --check with repeated exact releases and unresolved rows
expected: Plain list makes no requests; checked list reuses verdicts, age, latest and titles; review rows are retained at exit 1

scenario: Exact check with unavailable latest metadata or untitled advisory
expected: Latest is null without changing the verdict; advisory ID remains

scenario: Incomplete evidence without an advisory, deprecation or retraction finding
expected: Review and block installation

scenario: Configured JSON and explicit table for list; standalone check with table; list age flag without --check
expected: List accepts table override; unsupported flag combinations exit 2

scenario: List --check with unsupported source, conflicting lock evidence or failing provider
expected: Keep all rows; unresolved or unsupported declarations make no requests; provider failure follows the shared verdict contract

scenario: Exact release not found versus required metadata endpoint timing out or returning an invalid response
expected: Definitive not-found yields VERSION_UNAVAILABLE; lookup failure yields METADATA_UNAVAILABLE

scenario: Exact Pub release is retracted, with or without an incomplete advisory query
expected: RELEASE_RETRACTED yields fail and blocks installation; absent retraction evidence does not emit the code

scenario: OSV page contains no findings and carries a continuation token
expected: Continue until completion; a later active finding yields fail; an unfinished query yields review in the absence of a fail reason
